page.description: Harvester editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An open-source hyperconverged infrastructure solution built on Linux, KVM, and Kubernetes for running cloud-native workloads and VMs on bare-metal servers.
pros: 100% open-source with no license fees for HCI
Built on proven stack: Linux, KVM, Kubernetes, KubeVirt, Longhorn
Single-pane management for both VMs and container workloads
Active development by Rancher/SUSE with regular releases
cons: ISO images exceed 6 GB and no publisher SHA-256 digest is available; integrity cannot be verified at download time
No version or release date: editions omitted per policy for images >6 GB without a publisher digest
Requires bare-metal hardware with sufficient resources for hypervisor and VM workloads
The installer ISO is 7.7 GiB and the release publishes no checksum, so ROMinit lists it without pinned images.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Harvester; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: ISOs downloadable from releases.rancher.com but exceed 6 GB with no publisher checksum; omitted from editions per policy.
